attack_plan.narrative: Unusual activity continues to stir speculation around the Kremlin, where white smoke was observed on March 13th. This development has led to various theories, including the possibility that a new leader has been chosen. While the Kremlin released a photo of Putin and US President Obama, assuring the public that both leaders are well, the absence of Putin in other official capacities has raised concerns. Meanwhile, tweets from March 16th suggest that the Russian military is preparing for a parade marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation, which has fueled further speculation about the stability of the regime. A tweet from the same day hints that Putin might be 'binge watching' the TV series 'House of Cards,' though this remains unverified. Another tweet from March 16th notes that the Kremlin is preparing for an event, possibly related to St Patrick's Day, which has added to the mystery surrounding Putin's whereabouts. Sources close to Putin’s inner circle have hinted that his advisors and family members may be under house arrest or in hiding, a move that could indicate heightened political tension. The situation remains unclear, and the lack of clear communication from Russian authorities has only added to the speculation.
